description: This file defines the 'WorkWeek' entity class for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It models a work week, including daily work hours and whether each day is working or non-working, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: WorkWeek
classes.description: Entity class representing a work week configuration, including daily hours and linked operational country.

methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the work week record.
